name: Advance one real turn and read actual Government Plaza building and spy capacity

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'

steps.code: local o=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.CaptiveCapacityOutcome(); local ready=o.targetBuilt and ((o.stage=='TIER1_BUILT' and o.capacity==1 and o.buildingType~='BUILDING_GOV_SPIES') or (o.stage=='CAPACITY_READY' and o.capacity==2 and o.buildingType=='BUILDING_GOV_SPIES')); assert((o.stage=='PROGRESS_PENDING' or o.stage=='EFFECT_PENDING' or ready) and o.occupied==1 and o.captured==1,'capacity building or captive differs before real turn: '..o.stage); return o.stage..' '..o.buildingType

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; if not (p and p:IsTurnActive()) then return false end; local o=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.CaptiveCapacityOutcome(); return o.turn>o.progressTurn and (o.stage=='TIER1_BUILT' or o.stage=='CAPACITY_READY')

steps.code: local o=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.CaptiveCapacityOutcome(); assert(o.turn>o.progressTurn and o.targetBuilt and o.occupied==1 and o.captured==1,'native building or original captive not confirmed'); if o.buildingType=='BUILDING_GOV_SPIES' then assert(o.stage=='CAPACITY_READY' and o.capacity==2,'Intelligence Agency or native second capacity missing') else assert(o.stage=='TIER1_BUILT' and o.capacity==1,'native tier-one building not confirmed') end; return o.stage..' '..o.buildingType..' capacity='..o.capacity
